Blast-off — это ♥♥♥♥♥ не просто аркада. Это реактивный джампер/раннер/SHMUP, где твой альтер-эго — крошечный сгусток антиматерии, который хочет только одного: свалить из этой вселенной ♥♥♥♥♥. Проблема в том, что ты аннигилируешь при любом контакте с обычной материей, поэтому прыгать и стрелять придётся много и быстро.

Что тут ахуенно:
- Концепция и геймплей. Забудь про дурацкие платформы. Твой способ оставаться в воздухе — это подрывать врагов и ловить взрывной волной. Чем точнее выстрел, тем выше подкидывает. Идея не новая, но реализована на ура.
- Саундтрек и визуал. Стилизованная 2D-графика и больше 30 минут оригинального саундтрека задают настроение с первых секунд. В этой игре сложно не залипнуть.
- Хардкор. Сложность здесь ебануто растёт. Первые полчаса-час ты будешь ненавидеть и себя, и игру, и физику этого ебучего шара. Но если ты не расхуяришь клаву и въедешь в управление, то получишь настоящий кайф от контроля над движением.

За что игра посылает ♥♥♥♥♥:
- Кривое обучение. Эта игра — чистый тест на прочность для твоего терпения. Большинство новичков сбегут в течение первого часа, успев выдать фразу в стиле "эта ♥♥♥♥♥ никогда не взлетит".
- Техническая реализация. Игру запилили на Delphi, и это чувствуется. Частые вылеты, отсутствие настроек графики и невозможность переназначить управление делают игру неиграбельной для некоторых категорий игроков.
- Мало контента. Четыре локации — это всё, что тебе предложат. Бесконечный режим быстро надоедает, а соревноваться с живыми игроками у тебя не выйдет — только таблицы рекордов.

Вердикт: Blast-off — это дешёвая (особенно на скидках) игрушка для настоящих мазохистов. Она вырывает кусок из твоей психики, но дарит ни с чем не сравнимое чувство, когда твоя реакция и точность наконец-то синхронизируются. Если ты готов страдать и вкатываться — бери. Если нет — иди ♥♥♥♥♥, здесь тебе не место. Ставлю 7/10.

[h1]Reseña de \Blast-off\: Disparos y Carcajadas Cosmicas[/h1]

[h2]Resumen[/h2]
Si alguna vez has soñado con desintegrar alienígenas mientras evitas ser reducido a polvo cósmico, el nuevo juego \Blast-off\ podría ser tu nueva adicción... o frustración. Imagina un juego que mezcla la estrategia de un ajedrez con la frenética velocidad de un vendedor de hot dogs en hora pico. ¡Eso es \Blast-off\! Con un índice de aceptación superior al 80%, definitivamente algo bueno tiene que tener, ¿no?

[h2]Aspectos importantes e interesantes[/h2]
Uno de los grandes aciertos de \Blast-off\ es que te hace sentir en una película de ciencia ficción clase B donde los efectos especiales son tan malos que terminan siendo buenos. Los gráficos, aún sin ser de última generación, tienen ese encanto retro que podría hacerte derramar una lágrima nostálgica. Además, la IA tiene suficiente cerebro como para no dejarte ganar fácilmente, pero tampoco te frustras hasta amargar la vida.

La música es otro punto fuerte. Cada melodía es como una epopeya en sí misma, casi te hace querer estar en una nave espacial de verdad, con el mando a distancia de tu TV actuando como joystick.

[h2]Aspectos por mejorar[/h2]
Aunque \Blast-off\ tiene bastante encanto, la historia parece escrita por un robot adolescente durante su crisis existencial. No esperes una línea argumental que te haga reflexionar sobre la vida, el universo y todo lo demás. También podría mejorar en diversidad, el elenco de personajes parece sacado de un festival de clones.

Blast-off is an unusual hybrid of an endless/autorunner and a 2D retro top down twin stick shooter (except it's on PC so they didn't think that through very clearly).  Novel ideas, unfortunately, are not enough, alone, to carry a game to greatness.  The technical implementation here is weak, the visuals poor, the gameplay bland and uninteresting. 

From a technical perspective, the game doesn't meet basic minimum requirements that most PC gamers expect as standard.

While there are options to change the resolution for the game, all this does is scale up the simplistic 2D art assets used to make the game, which makes little or no difference to the graphics quality.  Without any other substantial graphics tweaks, it's not possible for gamers to improve the lacklustre 2D visuals.

The game features somewhat lazy, simplistic "retro" looking 2D graphics, and it's hard to say if this is due to the age of the assets used, if it's a deliberate attempt for the game to look bad/retro on purpose, or if the assets are just, well, terrible looking.  Considering this is being evaluated as a PC game in 2024, such poor quality 2D graphics in the 3D era just aren't good enough, whether it's a deliberate design fault on behalf of the developer or they just couldn't manage to do any better, this is a compromise gamers shouldn't have to put up with.

The developers didn't design the game for modern gaming PCs, as such the display resolution caps out at around 1440p, there's no support for the state-of-the-art 4K or higher resolutions.  The game simply won't look right on modern gaming displays due to this failure on the part of the developers.

The controls can't be customised, which will be an annoyance for many, but it can also render the game unplayable for differently-abled gamers, left handed gamers or gamers using AZERTY or other international keyboard layouts.  

Some of the defects in the game can be attributed to the choice of using the video game library/engine, Delphi.  Seriously, they tried to make a game with Delphi.  You can't make this stuff up.  It's rarely used, because it's arguably worse than construction kits like GameMaker Studio, RPGMaker and Clickteam Fusion, but it's also much harder to work with.  Despite this, Delphi has very limited capabilities, which go some way to explaining the poor quality of the game.  Just as you can't make a silk purse out of a sows ear, you can't make a great video game if you use a terrible engine.

These technical defects push this game below acceptable standards for any modern PC game.

You don't have to take my word about how bad the game is, we can measure the interest in a game by how much people bothered to play it.  Blast-off has achievements, and they show us a very clear picture that the game absolutely failed to capture any interest from gamers.  The most commonly and easily attained achievement is for shooting 100 times, trivial to achieve, but less than 7 percent of players bothered to get that far before uninstalling the game.  That's a tiny, tiny proportion of gamers who even bothered with this.  Ouch.

Reviewing SteamDB to check how popular this game was with players reveals a surprise... there's a very healthy spike in player counts for the game.  But this only happened once, and isn't consistent with the achievement stats, that show less than 7 percent of players bothered playing the game for any reasonable amount of time.  How is it possible for this game to have so many concurrent players who didn't bother engaging with this game?  Trading cards.  People will use card idling software to collect the cards and sell them, but this won't trigger any achievements in-game.

That tells us people only really bought this game for trading cards, and that's a damning indictment of the woeful quality.  A closer look at the numbers shows the game just has a couple of players every week running up the game and idling it for cards, then deleting it.  We must ask how it benefits gamers for there to be so many games like this, with little merit as a serious game, that only generate sales from people idling and selling the trading cards.

So, should you buy this game?

Blast-off is relatively cheap at $3 USD, but it's not worth it. Given the defects and quality issues with the game, coupled with the unrealistic price, this is impossible to recommend.  This is also competing with over 11,000 free games available on Steam, many of them far better than this paid product.

I am 32 years old.

My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and we adopted our son together. Both are now 4 years old.

When we were going through our separation, I felt lost and unhappy. I was self-destructive. One day, I was so angry with everything spiraling out of control that I punched a concrete wall in a moment of overwhelming emotion. This resulted in breaking my fifth metacarpal in my right hand—the hand I worked with, played games with, and used to carry my children to bed—the hand I desperately needed to ensure I could continue providing.

Upon learning the severity of the self-inflicted damage, I became almost suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man, with no history of depression or anxiety. I had never experienced anger outbursts, nor was I the type to break down and cry, but I was in a tough situation that truly prevented me from seeing the light on the other side.

With nothing better to do, I looked for a game I could play WITH ONE HAND while recovering. Somehow, I stumbled upon this game and read some of the comments. I decided it was worth a try... I must admit I didn't beat the game, nor did I play as much as some of you. In fact, I may have played this game for only a day or two. That being said, after doing so, I had a new joy and hope for life. I managed to leave behind the pain and suffering that had been thrust upon me. I could experience the joy and happineass of other people. I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ minutes listening to this music, long enough to realize that I would be okay.

After realizing this, I turned off the game and went back to work. My hand hurt a lot, but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so sorry for myself and became the father I needed to be at that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving like.

Today, I am close friends with the mother of my children. We don't fight, argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents and friends.

Now I have 3 children. My third child is, wait, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my separation, and we just unexpectedly stumbled into each other's lives. We have been dating for a year and are very happy together.

Moral of the story: you never know what life has in store for you, and if I had given up when all odds were against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

Thank you.

It costs 3 bucks and you'll get like an hour or two out of it before you get bored, which isn't too bad of a tradeoff so I'm happy to give it the thumbs up, however, you should know what you're getting into. The game actually has a very small amount of content which can be completed in about 5 minutes. The most replay I got out of it was from endless mode. There are only four modes in the game: Tutorial, bossfight, laserdance and endless. The marketing touts "four completely different locations", when in reality the locations are all the same, and the only thing that's different is the background art. The gameplay loop consists of trying to go as high and as fast as possible, which is enjoyable for lizard brain reasons. You have blue boost pads, you can explode enemies when they're close to and below you, and you can graze lasers while pressing up. Those are the three ways to pick up speed. This is where you will get your hour from.

As for me, I'm over it already.

Oyuncu, düşmanlardan kaçınırken zıplamalı ve ateş etmeli, kalkanları toplamalı ve uzay-zamandan geçip boşluğa ulaşmak için hızını artırmalıdır. Oyunda ayrıca tamamen farklı 4 konum, özel meydan okuma bölgeleri, 15 inanılmaz beceri ve özel bir patron düşman bulunuyor. Son teknoloji 2D grafikleri ve 30 dakikayı aşkın orijinal müzikleri ile oyun sürükleyici ve keyifli bir deneyim vaat ediyor. Ek olarak, oyunun liderlik tablolarına sahip sonsuz bir rekabetçi modu vardır ve bu da oyuna rekabetçi bir avantaj sağlar. Genel olarak, Blast-off zorlu ve bağımlılık yapan oyunlardan hoşlanan herkes için mutlaka oynanması gereken bir oyundur.
